title: Chest Filler
description: A simple QoL mod that let's you randomly fill a chest up however much you want.
body:
# Hi, and thank you for downloading my mod. 
 
This mod is great for Scripted servers where you have to navigate through a storage item without making the video look to obvious. Also has uses for other things.

The GUI and option to active the chest fill will show up when you open a storage item, the amount the chest is filled is configurable with percent. Additionally, there is a survival mode only toggle in which items only obtainable in vanilla survival will fill the chest. The amount of items and their randomness is different everytime.
